source.title: Claude Code native hook installer implementation

acquisition.details: Implemented `eyes install claude-code` and `eyes hook claude-code`. The installer writes idempotent UserPromptSubmit and Stop command hooks into Claude Code settings.json, preserving unrelated settings and existing hooks. The hook entrypoint records Claude Code UserPromptSubmit/Stop payloads through the normalized conversation path, fetches pending watcher messages for UserPromptSubmit, emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, commits the delivery cursor, and is silent for malformed payloads or a down daemon. README now documents the Claude Code install path. Verification: cargo fmt --check; cargo test claude --test daemon_spine; cargo test installs_claude_hooks_idempotently --lib; full cargo test; cargo install --path . --locked --root /private/tmp/extra-eyes-install-check --force; installed-binary smoke wrote sandbox Claude Code settings with both hooks.
